title: Luke Bible Quiz - Chapter 5
description: Ten questions on Luke 5: the great catch of fish, the man full of leprosy, the paralyzed man let down through the tiles, the calling of Levi and the new wine.

questions.text: Whose boat did Jesus enter and teach the multitudes from, by the lake of Gennesaret?
questions.explanation: He entered into one of the boats, which was Simon's, and asked him to put out a little from the land, and taught the multitudes from the boat.

answers.text: The boat of Zebedee
Simon's boat
The boat of James and John
A boat moored on the other side of the lake

questions.text: What did Simon answer when he was told to put out into the deep and let down the nets?
questions.explanation: Simon answered that they had worked all night and taken nothing, but that at his word he would let down the net.

answers.text: That the nets had already been washed
That his partners had gone home for the night
That the lake was too deep for the nets
That they had worked all night and taken nothing

questions.text: What happened when they let down the nets?
questions.explanation: They caught a great multitude of fish, their net was breaking, and when their partners came they filled both boats so that they began to sink.

answers.text: They caught so many fish that both boats began to sink
They caught nothing at all that day
Their boat was driven to the far shore
The fish broke through the side of the boat

questions.text: What did Simon Peter say when he fell down at Jesus' knees?
questions.explanation: He said, "Depart from me, for I am a sinful man, Lord."

answers.text: "Lord, I am not worthy of this catch"
"Who then is this that commands the fish?"
"Depart from me, for I am a sinful man, Lord"
"I will follow you wherever you go"

questions.text: What did Jesus tell Simon he would be doing from now on?
questions.explanation: He said to Simon, "Don't be afraid. From now on you will be catching people alive."

answers.text: Keeping the boats of his partners
Catching people alive
Washing the nets of the fishermen
Teaching in the synagogues

questions.text: What did Jesus say and do when the man full of leprosy begged to be made clean?
questions.explanation: He stretched out his hand and touched him, saying, "I want to. Be made clean," and immediately the leprosy left him.

answers.text: He sent him away to the priest first
He prayed over him through the night
He told him his faith had saved him
He touched him and said, "I want to. Be made clean"

questions.text: How did the men bring the paralyzed man to Jesus when the multitude blocked the way?
questions.explanation: Not finding a way to bring him in because of the multitude, they went up to the housetop and let him down through the tiles with his cot into the middle before Jesus.

answers.text: They let him down through the tiles of the housetop on his cot
They carried him in through the door of the house
They waited until the multitude had gone away
They called Jesus out into the street to him

questions.text: What did the scribes and the Pharisees begin to reason when Jesus said the man's sins were forgiven?
questions.explanation: They began to reason, saying, "Who is this that speaks blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, but God alone?"

answers.text: That he was a prophet sent from the Most High
That he had been sent to them from Jerusalem
That he spoke blasphemies, since God alone can forgive sins
That the man had never been paralyzed at all

questions.text: What did Levi the tax collector do when Jesus said, "Follow me"?
questions.explanation: Levi left everything, and rose up and followed him, and then made a great feast for him in his house.

answers.text: He asked for time to settle his accounts
He left everything and rose up and followed him
He stayed at the tax office
He called the other tax collectors first

questions.text: What did Jesus say happens when new wine is put into old wine skins?
questions.explanation: He said the new wine will burst the skins, and it will be spilled, and the skins will be destroyed; new wine must be put into fresh wine skins.

answers.text: The wine becomes old and better
Both the wine and the skins are preserved
The skins grow strong again
The new wine bursts the skins and is spilled
